detailed_descriptions.en: THE SIREN'S CALL A threatening drone activity has been reported in the mountains. Will you dare to explore the dangerous underground maze to put an end to this adversary? DEEP STATE A conspiracy is spreading in Auroa and seems to be related to the deep state in the United States. Investigate and reveal the dark secrets behind the conspiracy, codename "Wonderland." TRANSCENDENCE The work of Project Deus, a group of transhumanist scientists, is highly coveted by Sentinel Corp. Find their secret lair and protect its technology before it falls into the wrong hands. SPECIAL OPERATIONS FORCES PACK The Special Operations Forces Pack includes the "Quiet" DMR, ACH Cover, Crye G3 Combat Pants and Cross Draw Vest.
